overview.zh: 把智能计算项目连成可验证的证据链：问题与目标 → 方法与设计 → 核心模块 → 集成测试 → 报告和演示。
overview.en: Connect an intelligent-computing project through a verifiable chain: problem and objectives → method and design → core modules → integration and testing → report and demonstration.

reason.zh: 先确认阶段、交付物和考核条件，建立项目推进清单。
reason.en: First establish milestones, deliverables and assessment conditions.

reason.zh: 再理解智能计算的实质要求，将选题、分析、实现与验证连起来。
reason.en: Then connect topic selection, analysis, implementation and validation to intelligent-computing requirements.

reason.zh: 用提纲、模板与评分表检查各阶段的证据是否充分。
reason.en: Use outlines, templates and rubrics to check evidence at each stage.

overview.zh: 从说明会明确毕业项目的阶段交付、评分结构及必须满足的完成条件。
overview.en: Use the briefing to understand deliverables, grading structure and mandatory completion conditions.

sourceNote.zh: 来源为2026年9月30日说明会。日期与评审权重是该版本记录；第7页注明可调整，后续以eLearning最新通知为准。
sourceNote.en: Source: the 30 September 2026 briefing. Dates and panel weights describe that version; page 7 explicitly allows changes. Follow later eLearning announcements.

title.zh: 项目与考核结构
个人智能计算项目

explanation.zh: CAT405面向Data Analytics与Media Computing方向，项目按专业选题、由个人承担；注册前须已修CAT302和CAT304。个人责任与先修经历不能被团队分工替代。
explanation.en: CAT405 covers Data Analytics and Media Computing. Students undertake an individual project in their specialization, having taken CAT302 and CAT304; teamwork in earlier courses does not replace individual responsibility.

title.zh: 三里程碑与阶段证据

explanation.zh: 书面Proposal之后，里程碑1提交SRD报告并展示，里程碑2演示进度，里程碑3提交最终报告并做系统演示。每种交付证明不同阶段的工作，最终报告不能替代前面的展示。
explanation.en: After the written proposal, Milestone 1 requires an SRD report and presentation, Milestone 2 a progress demo, and Milestone 3 a final report and system demo. These demonstrate different stages of work.

title.zh: 五项交付权重

explanation.zh: 说明会列出SRD报告10%、SRD展示10%、进度演示20%、最终报告10%、最终展示与系统演示50%。前期报告与演示需分别准备，不能把里程碑1误读为只有一项10%。
explanation.en: The briefing assigns 10% to the SRD report, 10% to its presentation, 20% to the progress demo, 10% to the final report and 50% to final presentation and demonstration. Milestone 1 contains two separate components.

title.zh: 交付权重与评审来源

explanation.zh: 第7页给出Examiner40%、Supervisor50%、Industry10%（PIXEL2027），并注明可调整。这与第6页按交付物划分的权重是不同层次，不能直接把两组百分比相加。
explanation.en: Page 7 lists Examiner 40%, Supervisor 50% and Industry 10% (PIXEL 2027), subject to change. This describes assessor contributions, a different dimension from deliverable weights on page 6.

title.zh: 完成条件与持续推进
账户激活与竞标许可

explanation.zh: 收到SPTA账户激活邮件后先完成激活以查看题目；竞标须等待协调人后续指示。能浏览题目与已经开放竞标不是同一个状态。
explanation.en: Activate the SPTA account after receiving the activation email to view projects; bidding follows the coordinator's later instructions. Being able to browse does not mean bidding is open.

title.zh: 全部交付与最终演示门槛
title.en: All deliverables and the final-demo condition

explanation.zh: 所有阶段展示与Proposal、SRD、Final Report均须按要求完成。最终报告附系统安装手册/说明；第10页明确最终System Demo得F会导致总评F，因此不能仅用其他项目高分来推定通过。
explanation.en: Complete every required presentation and submit the proposal, SRD and final report. Include installation manuals/instructions as appendices. Page 10 explicitly states that an F in the final system demo produces an overall F.

title.zh: 提案提交与版本日期

explanation.zh: 本次说明会把Initial Proposal截止写为2026年10月18日，模板与指南在eLearning，软拷贝上传该平台。这里是版本记录；如学校后来调整，应核对新通知，不把旧日期当作永久安排。
explanation.en: The briefing gives 18 October 2026 as the initial-proposal deadline, points to eLearning templates and requires a softcopy upload there. This is dated guidance and must be checked against subsequent announcements.

title.zh: 沟通、更新与主动推进

explanation.zh: 定期与导师沟通、检查学校邮件和eLearning、主动推进并避免最后一刻赶工。每阶段都积累可展示的进展，才能及时得到反馈并纠正问题。
explanation.en: Maintain supervisor communication, check email and eLearning, work proactively and avoid last-minute work. Build demonstrable progress at every stage to obtain feedback and correct problems.

relation.zh: 个人责任通过各阶段交付体现
relation.en: Individual responsibility is evidenced by staged deliverables

relation.zh: 交付项分别对应评分项目
relation.en: Deliverables map to assessment components

relation.zh: 区分交付类别与评分来源
relation.en: Distinguish assessment components from assessor contributions

relation.zh: 竞标与分配后进入交付流程
relation.en: Bidding and assignment lead into the delivery workflow

relation.zh: 完成门槛要求每阶段持续推进
relation.en: Completion conditions require sustained work at each phase

prompt.zh: 学生想把CAT304团队项目直接视为CAT405的共同交付，哪项判断正确？
prompt.en: A student treats a CAT304 team submission as a joint CAT405 deliverable. Which interpretation is correct?

options.zh: CAT405仍是个人项目，应说明个人完成的智能计算工作
options.en: CAT405 remains individual and requires the student's own intelligent-computing work

options.zh: CAT304的组员必须共同注册同一CAT405题目
options.en: CAT304 teammates must register the same CAT405 topic

options.zh: CAT405按所有专业共同的网络基础设施方向选题
options.en: All CAT405 topics must follow the computing-infrastructure specialization

options.zh: 修过CAT304后无需再考虑CAT302先修要求
options.en: Taking CAT304 removes the CAT302 prerequisite

explanation.zh: 课件明确个人项目、专业方向及两门先修课程；不能从早期团队经历推导出本项目可以共同交付。
explanation.en: The slide specifies individual work, specialization and both prerequisites; earlier group work does not make this project a joint submission.

prompt.zh: 哪个组合正确对应里程碑2？
prompt.en: Which deliverable belongs to Milestone 2?

options.zh: Written Proposal与项目竞标
options.en: Written proposal and project bidding

options.zh: Project Progress Demo
options.en: Project Progress Demo

options.zh: SRD报告与SRD展示
options.en: SRD report and presentation

options.zh: Final Report与最终系统演示
options.en: Final report and final system demo

explanation.zh: 进度演示用于展示从需求设计到实现的进展；SRD和最终交付分别属于里程碑1和3。
explanation.en: The progress demo demonstrates implementation progress after analysis and design; SRD and final deliverables belong to Milestones 1 and 3.

prompt.zh: 按这页评分表，里程碑1合计占多少？
prompt.en: According to this slide, what is the total weight of Milestone 1?

options.zh: 10%，报告和展示共用一项分数
options.en: 10%, shared by the report and presentation

options.zh: 30%，含进度演示
options.en: 30%, including the progress demo

options.zh: 50%，等同最终展示与演示
options.en: 50%, identical to final presentation and demonstration

options.zh: 20%，由报告10%和展示10%构成
options.en: 20%, from a 10% report and 10% presentation

explanation.zh: 两项10%相加为20%；进度演示和最终演示属于后续里程碑。
explanation.en: The two 10% components total 20%; progress and final demonstrations belong to later milestones.

prompt.zh: 为什么不能把行业评审10%再加到第6页100%的交付权重上？
prompt.en: Why should the 10% industry contribution not simply be added to page 6's 100% deliverable weights?

options.zh: 行业评审10%自动取代SRD报告10%
options.en: The industry share automatically replaces the SRD report

options.zh: 评委40%表示四十份报告
options.en: The examiner share means forty reports

options.zh: 两张表划分的是评审来源与交付类型两个不同维度
options.en: The tables partition assessor contributions and deliverable types, two different dimensions

options.zh: 标有可调整意味着当前所有权重均为零
options.en: Subject to change means all current weights are zero

explanation.zh: 两张表的分类对象不同；后续调整须依据正式通知，而不是自行把比例累加。
explanation.en: The tables classify different things. Later changes need an official announcement, not arithmetic addition across the tables.

prompt.zh: 账户已激活、可以查看题目，但尚无竞标通知，应如何理解？
prompt.en: The account is activated and projects are visible, but bidding instructions have not arrived. What follows?

options.zh: 可以了解题目，正式竞标仍须等待通知
options.en: Review topics while waiting for the bidding instruction

options.zh: 账户激活就代表自动分配了题目
options.en: Activation automatically assigns a project

options.zh: 浏览题目就等于完成竞标提交
options.en: Viewing a topic completes a bid

options.zh: 必须再次注册新的学校身份才能竞标
options.en: A new university identity is required before bidding

explanation.zh: 激活提供访问能力，竞标开放是另一项流程决定。
explanation.en: Activation grants access; opening bidding is a separate workflow decision.

prompt.zh: 前期分数很高但最终System Demo为F，按说明会应如何判断？
prompt.en: Earlier marks are high, but the final system demo receives F. How does the briefing treat this?

options.zh: 总评为F；最终演示有明确的通过门槛
options.en: Overall F; the final demo has an explicit completion condition

options.zh: 只扣除该演示对应分数，再按加权平均决定
options.en: Only deduct the demo marks and use the weighted mean

options.zh: 可用最终报告替代演示并保留原成绩
options.en: Replace the demo with a final report and retain other marks

options.zh: 补交Proposal即可自动改变演示等级
options.en: Submitting the proposal later automatically changes the demo grade

explanation.zh: 课件列出特别条件：最终演示F导致总评F，普通加权直觉不能覆盖这条要求。
explanation.en: The explicit rule makes a final-demo F an overall F; ordinary weighted-average reasoning does not override it.

prompt.zh: 准备提交提案时发现后来有新的eLearning截止通知，哪种做法合适？
prompt.en: A later eLearning deadline announcement appears when preparing a proposal. What is appropriate?

options.zh: 无论后续通知如何都只使用旧幻灯片日期
options.en: Use the old slide date regardless of later announcements

options.zh: 把最终报告截止当成提案截止
options.en: Use the final-report deadline for the proposal

options.zh: 核对新通知并按更新要求提交，同时保留版本依据
options.en: Check the newer announcement and submit under the updated requirements

options.zh: 只交给同学转达即可代替平台上传
options.en: Ask a classmate to relay it instead of uploading

explanation.zh: 第11页提供当时日期，第12页说明资料会更新；平台新通知应纳入提交检查。
explanation.en: Page 11 provides the dated instruction and page 12 says materials are updated; incorporate later announcements into submission checks.

prompt.zh: 哪种推进节奏最符合说明会建议？
prompt.en: Which work pattern best follows the briefing?

options.zh: 把导师沟通集中到最终演示前一周
options.en: Concentrate supervisor discussions in the week before the final demo

options.zh: 仅在提交报告时检查课程更新
options.en: Check course updates only when submitting reports

options.zh: 定期展示阶段成果并检查新通知，按反馈调整后续任务
options.en: Regularly show staged results, check announcements and adjust tasks using feedback

options.zh: 阶段演示后暂停开发直到下次评分前
options.en: Stop development after each review until just before the next assessment

explanation.zh: 持续沟通、主动性与每阶段投入能够支持渐进完成；间歇突击容易错过反馈和变更。
explanation.en: Continuity, initiative and effort at every phase support gradual completion; isolated bursts can miss feedback and changes.

reason.zh: 封面、出席/协调人信息、指南链接页或结束页；不设独立知识点。
reason.en: Cover, attendance/coordinator information, a guideline link or closing slide; no independent concept.

overview.zh: 把毕业项目的五阶段流程与智能计算的选题、方法、证据和成果要求连接起来。
overview.en: Connect the five project phases with intelligent-computing topic, method, evidence and outcome requirements.

sourceNote.zh: 本指南适用于三类毕业项目；此整理覆盖共享要求与CAT405专章，CAT403/404专章不混入本课。第5页学年写法与封面不一致；日期表明确可能调整，按eLearning最新通知核对。
sourceNote.en: The guide covers three specializations; these notes cover shared requirements and the CAT405 chapter, without importing CAT403/404-specific criteria. Page 5 has a session-label inconsistency. Timelines may change and should be checked against current eLearning announcements.

title.zh: 流程、里程碑与支持系统
项目性质与先修条件

explanation.zh: 项目为个人承担、8学分、跨第一和第二学期、100% coursework；CAT405对应智能计算方向，注册前须已修CAT302和CAT304。
explanation.en: The individual project carries eight units across Semesters I and II and is assessed entirely through coursework. CAT405 is the intelligent-computing specialization, with CAT302 and CAT304 prerequisites.

title.zh: 多轮竞标与专业匹配

explanation.zh: 在SPTA准确更新技能与经历，按自己的专业代码竞标题目；未获分配者可参加后续轮次。获分配后在导师指导和评委评审下推进，个人资料是选题匹配的依据。
explanation.en: Update skills and experience accurately in SPTA and bid within the correct specialization. Unassigned students can enter later rounds. Assigned projects proceed with a supervisor and examiners; the profile supports matching.

title.zh: 提案审阅与反馈

explanation.zh: 初始提案依照本专业提纲/模板准备，由研究群组审阅；群组不为初始提案评分，但反馈会传达给学生、导师和评委。未计分不代表可以略过它。
explanation.en: Prepare the proposal with specialization-specific outlines and templates. Research-cluster review is ungraded, but its feedback is shared with the student, supervisor and examiners. Ungraded does not mean optional.

title.zh: 需求与设计的双重交付

explanation.zh: 阶段3收集需求并分析系统，交付SRD报告及展示。时间表把报告准备安排在2026年11月2日至29日、展示安排在11月30日至12月13日；具体时点仍须核对平台。
explanation.en: Phase 3 gathers requirements and analyzes the system, producing both an SRD report and presentation. The guide schedules preparation for 2–29 November 2026 and presentation for 30 November–13 December, subject to updates.

title.zh: 基于设计的进度演示
title.en: Progress demo grounded in the design

explanation.zh: 进度阶段展示阶段3分析设计对应的实现。时间表把原型开发与测试放在2026年12月14日至2027年3月7日，进度演示安排在第二学期3月8日至21日；应能说明已实现的模块及剩余工作。
explanation.en: The progress review demonstrates implementation based on Phase 3 analysis/design. The timeline places prototyping and tests in 14 December 2026–7 March 2027 and the review in 8–21 March. Explain completed modules and remaining work.

title.zh: 集成、测试与最终交付

explanation.zh: 最终阶段把子系统集成并测试为可运行的完整系统，同时提交最终报告。时间表列最终报告准备为2027年5月10日至16日、演示为5月17日至30日，PIXEL为6月7日至13日；这些是可调整的时间窗。
explanation.en: The final phase integrates and tests a working complete system and submits its report. The guide lists report preparation for 10–16 May 2027, demos for 17–30 May and PIXEL for 7–13 June, all as changeable windows.

title.zh: SPTA与eLearning的分工

explanation.zh: SPTA支持题目竞标、评委分配与教师录入成绩；eLearning用于课程通知与提案、SRD、最终报告的提交。指南还要求相应软拷贝交导师，最终报告交导师及评委；应核对各交付的接收渠道。
explanation.en: SPTA supports bidding, examiner assignment and staff grade entry. eLearning carries announcements and proposal/SRD/final-report submissions. The guide also specifies supervisor copies, and final copies for supervisors/examiners; check each delivery channel.

title.zh: 智能计算项目的实质
能力与成果链

explanation.zh: 学习成果包括系统设计与算法分析、编程和研究方法、清晰表达、职业伦理、连接文献与新思路、市场潜力。项目证据要覆盖技术、沟通及专业实践，而不只有代码数量。
explanation.en: Outcomes include system design/algorithm analysis, programming and research methods, communication, ethics, connections from literature to new ideas, and market potential. Evidence spans technical and professional work, not just code volume.

title.zh: 智能计算组成与载体

explanation.zh: 项目可为Web、桌面、移动、嵌入式或组合系统，但主要贡献必须含解决问题的智能计算方法。采用Web界面本身并不自动满足智能计算要求。
explanation.en: Projects may be web, standalone, mobile, embedded or combined systems, but their main contribution must use intelligent-computing methods to solve the problem. A web interface alone does not satisfy that requirement.

title.zh: 选择理由—构建步骤—结果—集成

explanation.zh: 评价关注为何选择该智能方法、怎样构建解决方案、得到什么结果及如何集成为一个项目。提案须清楚写明方法/技术，展示时让这四类证据相互对应。
explanation.en: Evaluation asks why the method was chosen, how the solution was built, what results were obtained and how it was integrated. Specify the method in the proposal and align these four evidence types.

title.zh: 已有方法与项目贡献

explanation.zh: 指南允许已有或改进的智能计算方法，项目不必是全新的想法、系统或算法。关键在于适用的问题、明确方法、学生实现与评估证据；不能把“允许已有方法”理解为无需解释贡献。
explanation.en: Existing or improved intelligent methods are allowed; a wholly new idea, system or algorithm is not mandatory. A suitable problem, clear method and the student's implementation/evaluation evidence still matter.

title.zh: 核心计算领域与问题匹配
title.en: Core computing areas and problem fit

explanation.zh: 参考领域包括计算科学、人机交互、智能系统、图形与可视化、AI、大数据、数据挖掘和机器学习。领域清单用于定位选题，具体项目仍须明确其智能方法及解决的问题。
explanation.en: Referenced areas include computational science, HCI, intelligent systems, graphics/visualization, AI, big data, data mining and machine learning. These locate a topic but do not replace its specific problem and intelligent method.

relation.zh: 分配题目后细化问题与方案
relation.en: Refine the problem and solution after assignment

relation.zh: 把初始方案展开为需求与设计
relation.en: Expand the initial idea into requirements and design

relation.zh: 将设计落实为可演示模块
relation.en: Turn design into demonstrable modules

relation.zh: 从局部进展走向集成测试与交付
relation.en: Move from partial progress to integration, testing and delivery

relation.zh: 通过正式渠道提交并获取反馈
relation.en: Submit and receive feedback through official channels

relation.zh: 智能贡献需要方法与结果证据
relation.en: An intelligent contribution needs method and result evidence

relation.zh: 已有方法也必须解释选择与完成过程
relation.en: Existing methods still need rationale and execution evidence

relation.zh: 领域定位进一步落实为智能组件
relation.en: Translate the field into an intelligent component

relation.zh: 以完整成果展示综合能力
relation.en: Demonstrate integrated capabilities through final deliverables

prompt.zh: 哪项正确描述项目的课程性质？
prompt.en: Which description matches the course format?

options.zh: 团队项目，主要由期末闭卷考试评分
options.en: Team project mainly assessed by a closed-book final exam

options.zh: 个人项目，跨两个学期，100% coursework
options.en: Individual project across two semesters, assessed entirely by coursework

options.zh: 个人项目，只在第一学期完成且有60%期末考试
options.en: Individual one-semester project with a 60% final exam

options.zh: 八学分团队项目，可用CAT304分数直接替代
options.en: Eight-unit team project that directly reuses CAT304 marks

explanation.zh: 指南把个人、学分、学期和考核方式分别列明；不要沿用其他课程的团队或考试结构。
explanation.en: The guide specifies individual work, units, semesters and assessment separately; structures from other courses do not carry over.

prompt.zh: 第一轮未获项目后，流程图建议如何继续？
prompt.en: What happens after an unsuccessful first bidding round?

options.zh: 直接跳到最终系统演示
options.en: Move directly to the final system demo

options.zh: 将其他专业题目自动视为已获分配
options.en: Treat another specialization's topic as automatically assigned

options.zh: 继续参加后续项目竞标轮次
options.en: Enter subsequent project-bidding rounds

options.zh: 先交最终报告即可免除项目分配
options.en: Submit a final report to bypass project assignment

explanation.zh: 流程中的失败分支返回竞标，不是结束项目或跳过选题。
explanation.en: The unsuccessful branch loops back to bidding rather than ending the project or bypassing assignment.

prompt.zh: 为什么仍应认真处理不计分的初始提案反馈？
prompt.en: Why act on feedback for the ungraded initial proposal?

options.zh: 不计分意味着反馈会被删除且不可用于后续工作
options.en: Ungraded feedback is deleted and cannot inform later work

options.zh: 群组不评分就等于免交提案
options.en: No cluster grade means no proposal submission is required

options.zh: 反馈帮助校准问题与方案，并会供后续导师和评审参考
options.en: It improves the problem and solution and informs later supervision and review

options.zh: 初始提案自动取代SRD报告
options.en: The proposal automatically replaces the SRD report

explanation.zh: 反馈具有指导后续阶段的作用，评分与必需交付是两个维度。
explanation.en: Feedback guides later work; grading and required participation are distinct.

prompt.zh: SRD阶段只有报告、没有展示，缺少哪类证据？
prompt.en: An SRD phase has a report but no presentation. What is missing?

options.zh: 向评审说明需求与设计并回应问题的展示
options.en: A presentation explaining requirements/design and responding to review

options.zh: 只有最终系统的安装包
options.en: Only the final installation package

options.zh: 行业商业化评分
options.en: Only industry commercialization scoring

options.zh: 竞标时的个人技能资料
options.en: Only the profile used for bidding

explanation.zh: SRD报告和展示是分别要求的交付；后续系统演示不替代这一阶段的说明。
explanation.en: The report and presentation are separately required; a later system demo does not replace this stage.

prompt.zh: 哪种进度展示最能体现阶段3到阶段4的连接？
prompt.en: Which progress demonstration best connects Phases 3 and 4?

options.zh: 按原模块设计演示已实现功能，并说明偏差及剩余任务
options.en: Demonstrate implemented functions against the module design and explain deviations and remaining tasks

options.zh: 把同一份提案再朗读一次作为全部进度
options.en: Reread the proposal as the complete progress report

options.zh: 只改变项目名称以显示发展
options.en: Change only the title to indicate progress

options.zh: 先提交最终报告，无需展示运行模块
options.en: Submit the final report without showing working modules

explanation.zh: 进度必须体现基于先前需求设计的实现证据；更换表达或重复提案不能证明模块进展。
explanation.en: Progress requires implementation evidence grounded in earlier design; renaming or repeating a proposal does not demonstrate it.

prompt.zh: 各模块单独能运行，但联动失败，最直接未满足哪项最终要求？
prompt.en: Modules work separately but fail together. Which final requirement is most directly unmet?

options.zh: 准备一份研究群组提案
options.en: Preparing a research-cluster proposal

options.zh: 更新竞标技能资料
options.en: Updating the bidding skills profile

options.zh: 说明项目的专业代码
options.en: Stating the specialization code

options.zh: 整合并测试一个完整可运行系统
options.en: Integrating and testing a complete working system

explanation.zh: 最终阶段要求集成后的整体可用性；单模块成功并不证明系统级工作完成。
explanation.en: Final delivery requires integrated system operation; individual module success does not prove system-level completion.

prompt.zh: 学生要确认最新项目公告并上传SRD报告，应首先查看哪个系统？
prompt.en: Where should a student check current announcements and upload an SRD report?

options.zh: SPTA的成绩录入界面
options.en: The SPTA grade-entry screen

options.zh: 只使用个人本地文件夹即可完成平台提交
options.en: A personal local folder alone completes submission

options.zh: eLearning；SPTA主要处理项目管理流程
options.en: eLearning; SPTA mainly handles project-management workflows

options.zh: 仅更新SPTA技能简介即可代替报告上传
options.en: Updating the SPTA skills profile replaces uploading the report

explanation.zh: 两平台分工不同，竞标管理不能替代课程通知与文档提交。
explanation.en: The systems have different roles; bidding management does not replace announcements and document submission.

prompt.zh: 哪份项目证据组合更符合CAT405的学习成果？
prompt.en: Which evidence set better matches CAT405 outcomes?

options.zh: 代码行数与开发电脑型号
options.en: Code line count and developer-machine model

options.zh: 仅UI截图与封面设计
options.en: Only interface screenshots and cover design

options.zh: 方法分析、实现与测试、文献联系、清晰展示和伦理实践记录
options.en: Method analysis, implementation/tests, literature connections, clear presentation and ethical practice

options.zh: 仅项目最终价格而无技术论证
options.en: Only a final price without technical justification

explanation.zh: 成果跨实践、认知、沟通、伦理、个人学习与创业等方面，应提供相应证据。
explanation.en: Outcomes span practice, cognition, communication, ethics, independent learning and entrepreneurship, each needing evidence.

prompt.zh: 一个普通信息展示网页，怎样才能论证符合本课程的核心要求？
prompt.en: How could an ordinary information website substantiate the core course requirement?

options.zh: 明确解决问题的智能计算组件及其方法、实现和结果
options.en: Identify an intelligent component, its method, implementation and results addressing the problem

options.zh: 仅把网页改成手机端布局
options.en: Only change it to a mobile layout

options.zh: 仅增加服务器数量
options.en: Only add servers

options.zh: 仅使用更复杂的页面动画
options.en: Only add more elaborate page animations

explanation.zh: 系统载体与智能方法贡献不同，必须说明智能组件怎样解决问题。
explanation.en: Delivery platform differs from an intelligent-method contribution; explain how that component solves the problem.

prompt.zh: 已有漂亮结果图，但无法解释算法选择和系统整合，缺口是什么？
prompt.en: Results look good, but the method choice and integration cannot be explained. What is missing?

options.zh: 只缺少更多相同结果截图
options.en: Only more screenshots of the same result

options.zh: 只缺少另一种界面配色
options.en: Only another color palette

options.zh: 只缺少把项目改名为AI系统
options.en: Only renaming the project an AI system

options.zh: 方法选择理由与完整系统证据
options.en: Method rationale and complete-system evidence

explanation.zh: 结果是必要的一环，但不能代替选择理由、构建过程和整体集成。
explanation.en: Results are one required link, not a substitute for rationale, construction and integration.

prompt.zh: 采用已有机器学习方法是否必然不符合CAT405？
prompt.en: Does using an existing machine-learning method necessarily disqualify a CAT405 project?

options.zh: 不会，仍需合理选择、实现、结果与集成证据
options.en: No; justified selection, implementation, results and integration are still required

options.zh: 会，所有项目都必须提出全新算法
options.en: Yes; every project must invent a new algorithm

options.zh: 不会，因此无需说明方法如何工作
options.en: No, so explaining the method is unnecessary

options.zh: 只要换一个英文算法名称就满足原创性
options.en: Renaming an algorithm in English establishes originality

explanation.zh: 文件允许已有方法，但评价其应用和完成过程；新颖性要求与实际贡献不能混为一谈。
explanation.en: The guide allows existing methods while evaluating their application and execution; novelty and contribution are distinct.

prompt.zh: 选题写着“机器学习”，是否已充分说明项目方案？
prompt.en: Is labeling a topic 'machine learning' enough to specify the solution?

options.zh: 足够，领域名称等同系统需求
options.en: Yes; the field name is equivalent to system requirements

options.zh: 不够，还需明确问题、具体方法与可验证成果
options.en: No; specify the problem, method and verifiable outcomes

options.zh: 足够，核心领域不需要方法论证
options.en: Yes; core areas require no methodological rationale

options.zh: 不够，必须同时覆盖清单中全部领域
options.en: No; every listed field must be included

explanation.zh: 领域是定位，方法和评价才把宽泛方向变成可实施项目；不要求覆盖所有领域。
explanation.en: A field locates the topic; method and evaluation make it implementable. Covering every field is not required.

reason.zh: 封面与目录、协调人行政信息，或CAT403/CAT404专属章节；本整理聚焦共享流程与CAT405。
reason.en: Cover/contents, coordinator administration, or CAT403/CAT404-specific chapters; this guide focuses on shared processes and CAT405.

overview.zh: 把毕业项目资料包变成可操作的交付路线：提出问题与方案，完成需求设计，提供实现和测试证据，再按阶段评分标准检查报告与演示。
overview.en: Turn the project package into an actionable delivery route: frame a problem and solution, develop requirements and design, produce implementation and testing evidence, and review reports and demonstrations against stage-specific rubrics.

sourceNote.zh: 来源为下载的 ZIP 内提案指南与模板、SRD 和最终报告提纲、报告模板、演示模板、评分表及空白反馈表。扫描提纲已按原图核对。ZIP 没有统一页码，以下按内部文件或章节注明来源；图中的个人信息栏是待填模板。评分表的阶段占比和表内维度占比属于不同层级，须分开理解。
sourceNote.en: Sources are the downloaded ZIP's proposal guidelines and template, SRD and final-report outlines, report template, presentation templates, rubrics and blank feedback form. Scanned outlines were checked visually. The ZIP has no unified pagination; internal files or sections are identified below. Personal-information fields are blank template fields. Stage weights and within-rubric weights are different levels and must be interpreted separately.

title.zh: 一、提案：把想法写成可验证的项目
背景、问题与目标的证据链
title.en: Evidence chain from background to objectives

explanation.zh: 先说明相关人员、场景和流程，再指出具体问题及影响，解释为何值得解决，最后列出能检查是否完成的目标。目标应回应问题，而不是只罗列准备采用的技术。来源：CAT405_Init_Proposal_Guidelines，第 1 页；提案 DOCX 的 Background、Problem Statement、Motivation、Objectives。
explanation.en: Describe the people, setting and process, identify a concrete problem and its effects, explain the motivation, then state objectives whose completion can be checked. Objectives should respond to the problem rather than merely list technologies. Source: CAT405_Init_Proposal_Guidelines, internal page 1; proposal DOCX sections Background, Problem Statement, Motivation and Objectives.

title.zh: 明确智能计算方法及解决过程
title.en: Specify the intelligent-computing method and solution process

explanation.zh: Proposed Solution 应说明拟采用的智能计算方法、关键步骤和它如何处理已识别的问题；可用流程图辅助，并给图编号。不能只写“加入 AI”而省略输入、处理和输出之间的关系。来源：提案指南 Proposed Solution；提案 DOCX 的 Proposed Solution。
explanation.en: The Proposed Solution should identify the intelligent-computing method, its main steps and how it addresses the identified problem. A numbered flowchart can support the explanation. 'Add AI' is insufficient without the relationship between inputs, processing and outputs. Source: proposal guidelines and proposal DOCX, Proposed Solution.

title.zh: 贡献、预期成果与项目状态
title.en: Contribution, expected outcomes and project status

explanation.zh: Benefit/Impact 解释受益者和价值，Uniqueness 解释相对已有工作的改进，Expected Outcomes 列出将交付的成果。项目状态要区分新项目、扩展既有范围的 continuation、以及改进已有完整系统性能或功能的 enhancement。来源：提案指南第 1–2 页。这里的独特性按课程项目说明理解。
explanation.en: Benefit/Impact explains beneficiaries and value, Uniqueness identifies improvement relative to existing work, and Expected Outcomes lists deliverables. Distinguish a new project, a continuation extending existing scope, and an enhancement improving a completed system's performance or functionality. Source: proposal guidelines, internal pages 1–2. Uniqueness here is the course's project-description criterion.

title.zh: 摘要与可持续发展目标对应
title.en: Abstract and Sustainable Development Goal alignment

explanation.zh: 提案摘要应简短、自成一体且不超过一页，概括动机、目标、方法、预期结果和结论方向；背景部分限制为最多三段。SDG 对应要解释项目活动或结果与所选目标之间的联系，不只是放一个目标图标。来源：提案 DOCX 的 Abstract、Background、SDG；SRD/最终报告提纲的 SDG 要求。
explanation.en: The proposal abstract should be self-contained and no longer than one page, covering motivation, objectives, techniques, expected results and the conclusion direction; Background is limited to three paragraphs. SDG alignment should explain the connection between project activities or outcomes and the selected goal, not merely display an icon. Source: proposal DOCX, Abstract, Background and SDG; SDG requirements in the SRD/final-report outlines.

title.zh: 计划、里程碑与可追溯引用

explanation.zh: 提案附录的 Gantt 图应包含任务、里程碑和交付物，而不只是月份色块。正文借用的观点或方法应引用来源，并按 APA、Harvard 或 IEEE 等选定格式一致列出参考文献。来源：提案指南第 2 页；提案与报告 DOCX 的 References、Appendix。
explanation.en: The proposal appendix's Gantt chart should include tasks, milestones and deliverables rather than only coloured month blocks. Cite borrowed ideas or methods in the text and list references consistently using a chosen style such as APA, Harvard or IEEE. Source: proposal guidelines, internal page 2; proposal/report DOCX sections References and Appendix.

title.zh: 二、需求与设计：说明为什么这样建
title.en: 2. Requirements and design: justify what will be built

title.zh: 相关工作与方案定位

explanation.zh: Related Work 不只是逐篇摘要。应比较相关系统、算法或理论的长处和限制，说明自己的方案处在什么位置，并与新项目、续作或改进的状态保持一致。来源：CAT405_System Requirements and Design_Report_Outline，第 1 页；报告模板 Related Works。
explanation.en: Related Work is more than a sequence of summaries. Compare strengths and limitations of relevant systems, algorithms or theories, position the proposed work, and keep that positioning consistent with its new/continuation/enhancement status. Source: CAT405_System Requirements and Design_Report_Outline, internal page 1; report template, Related Works.

title.zh: 需求范围与获取证据

explanation.zh: 需求分析要定义系统能力、边界与限制，并说明需求从何而来，例如调查或问卷。功能愿望、已确认需求和超出范围的想法需要区分，后续设计与测试才有稳定依据。来源：SRD 提纲第 2 页的 Scope、Requirements Gathering；报告模板 Requirement Analysis。
explanation.en: Requirements analysis should define system capabilities, boundaries and limitations, and explain how requirements were elicited, for example through surveys or questionnaires. Distinguish desired features, confirmed requirements and out-of-scope ideas so design and testing have a stable basis. Source: SRD outline, internal page 2, Scope and Requirements Gathering; report template, Requirement Analysis.

title.zh: 开发方法与风险计划

explanation.zh: SRD 要说明适合项目的开发方法，例如 waterfall、agile、prototype、spiral、iterative/incremental 或 RAD，并用工作分解、Gantt 图、里程碑和 SWOT 等工具支撑计划。选择应与需求稳定性、反馈需求和风险相符。来源：SRD 提纲第 2 页，Development Methodology 与 Project Planning。
explanation.en: The SRD should explain a development method suited to the project, such as waterfall, agile, prototyping, spiral, iterative/incremental development or RAD, supported by work breakdown, a Gantt chart, milestones and SWOT. The choice should fit requirement stability, feedback needs and risks. Source: SRD outline, internal page 2, Development Methodology and Project Planning.

title.zh: 用合适的图表达不同设计问题
title.en: Use suitable diagrams for different design questions

explanation.zh: 模块图说明组成与职责，体系结构图说明部件关系，流程图或伪代码说明处理逻辑，UML 用例、类、序列或状态图在适用时表达相应视角。应选择能解释设计的图，并保持相互一致，不要求机械地画齐所有图种。来源：SRD 提纲第 2 页；最终报告提纲 Design and Implementation。
explanation.en: A module diagram explains parts and responsibilities; architecture shows component relationships; flowcharts or pseudocode express processing logic; UML use-case, class, sequence or state diagrams provide their relevant views when applicable. Select diagrams that clarify the design and keep them consistent, rather than mechanically including every type. Source: SRD outline, internal page 2; final-report outline, Design and Implementation.

title.zh: 数据、工具与实现条件

explanation.zh: 涉及数据学习的项目应交代数据来源以及适用的训练和测试安排；同时列明硬件、软件、操作系统、开发工具、服务器、语言和关键算法等必要条件。说明应足以理解方案如何落地，而不是与设计无关的工具堆砌。来源：SRD 提纲第 2 页，Dataset、Hardware/Software Requirements。
explanation.en: Data-learning projects should explain data sources and applicable training/testing arrangements, alongside necessary hardware, software, operating systems, development tools, servers, languages and key algorithms. The information should make the implementation understandable rather than become an unrelated tool inventory. Source: SRD outline, internal page 2, Dataset and Hardware/Software Requirements.

title.zh: 三、最终报告：用证据解释实现与效果
title.en: 3. Final report: evidence for implementation and outcomes

title.zh: 从需求设计到可解释的实现
title.en: From requirements and design to explainable implementation

explanation.zh: 最终报告需根据反馈修订前期内容，再说明体系结构、组件和智能方法的实际实现、处理过程、适用的数据库与界面设计，并解释技术取舍和实现策略。图、代码说明和系统行为应互相对应。来源：CAT405_Final_Report_Outline，第 1–2 页；报告模板 Design and Implementation。
explanation.en: Revise earlier content using feedback, then explain the implemented architecture, components, intelligent method, processing steps, applicable database/UI design, technical trade-offs and implementation strategy. Diagrams, implementation explanations and system behaviour should correspond. Source: CAT405_Final_Report_Outline, internal pages 1–2; report template, Design and Implementation.

title.zh: 测试层次、用例选择与覆盖证据
title.en: Testing levels, case selection and coverage evidence

explanation.zh: 最终报告要求说明测试策略、用例选择方法、执行结果和覆盖情况，并证明系统满足需求。unit、integration、system、acceptance 测试分别关注不同范围；详细测试记录可放附录，但正文应解释关键结论。来源：最终报告提纲第 1–2 页，Testing and Evaluation。
explanation.en: The final report calls for the testing strategy, case-selection method, results and coverage, with evidence that requirements are met. Unit, integration, system and acceptance tests address different scopes. Detailed records may be appended, but the main text should explain the key findings. Source: final-report outline, internal pages 1–2, Testing and Evaluation.

title.zh: 评价、局限与有依据的未来工作
title.en: Evaluation, limitations and justified future work

explanation.zh: 对照目标讨论结果和适用性，说明与相关系统相比的优点与限制，再提出有依据的改进方向。结论应回答目标达到什么程度；未来工作应来自已知限制或可验证需求，避免没有证据的效果承诺。来源：最终报告提纲第 2 页，Evaluation、Conclusion and Future Work。
explanation.en: Discuss results and fitness for purpose against the objectives, explain strengths and limitations relative to relevant systems, and propose justified improvements. The conclusion should state how far objectives were achieved; future work should follow known limitations or verifiable needs rather than unsupported performance promises. Source: final-report outline, internal page 2, Evaluation, Conclusion and Future Work.

title.zh: 双语摘要、引用和附录的职责
title.en: Roles of bilingual abstracts, references and appendices

explanation.zh: 报告模板包含 Malay 与 English 摘要、原创声明、正文、参考文献和附录。两种摘要应表达相同项目要点；正文引用要可追溯到参考文献；详细代码、长表和补充图可放附录并编号，正文仍要解释核心论证。来源：CAT405_Report_Template，前置页、References、Appendices。
explanation.en: The report template contains Malay and English abstracts, an originality declaration, main chapters, references and appendices. The abstracts should express equivalent project essentials; in-text citations should trace to references; detailed code, long tables and supplementary diagrams may be numbered in appendices while the main text explains the central argument. Source: CAT405_Report_Template, preliminary pages, References and Appendices.

title.zh: 四、评分表：区分阶段权重与证据维度
title.en: 4. Rubrics: distinguish stage weights and evidence dimensions

title.zh: 两层百分比不能直接相加
title.en: Do not directly add percentages from different levels

explanation.zh: 评分表标题的 Overall Marks 表示该环节对总成绩的权重，表内各 criterion 的百分比表示该环节内部如何分配。比如 Progress 占总成绩 20%，其中 Implementation 占该环节 30%，满额时相当于总成绩 6 个百分点。来源：CAT405 Rubric 2.0 Project Progress Demonstration；其他 rubric 标题及表内 Weight。
explanation.en: Overall Marks in a rubric title is that component's contribution to the course grade; criterion percentages allocate marks within that component. For example, Progress is 20% overall and Implementation is 30% within Progress, corresponding to 6 percentage points overall at full credit. Source: CAT405 Rubric 2.0 Project Progress Demonstration; rubric titles and Weight columns.

title.zh: SRD 报告的四类评价证据
title.en: Four evidence categories in the SRD report rubric

explanation.zh: SRD Report 总体占 10%。内部 Contents 60% 检查问题、已有方法、数据与计划等内容及写作规范；Proposed Solution 20% 看智能方法、模块/体系结构及选择理由；Organization 10% 看组织；SDG 10% 看目标对应。来源：CAT405 Rubric 1.1 System Requirements and Design Report。
explanation.en: The SRD Report contributes 10% overall. Internally, Contents 60% covers the problem, existing methods, data, planning and writing quality; Proposed Solution 20% examines the intelligent method, modules/architecture and justification; Organization 10% examines structure; SDG 10% examines alignment. Source: CAT405 Rubric 1.1 System Requirements and Design Report.

title.zh: SRD 答辩需要正确解释和有序表达
title.en: SRD presentation needs correct explanation and organised delivery

explanation.zh: SRD Presentation 总体占 10%；内部 Subject Knowledge 50%、Confidence 20%、Logical Organization 20%、Completeness/Accuracy 10%。准备重点是解释智能方法为何合适、能准确回答问题，再用清楚顺序和稳定表达展示内容。来源：CAT405 Rubric 1.2 System Requirements and Design Presentation。
explanation.en: The SRD Presentation contributes 10% overall; internally, Subject Knowledge is 50%, Confidence 20%, Logical Organization 20%, and Completeness/Accuracy 10%. Prepare to explain why the intelligent method is appropriate and answer questions accurately, supported by a coherent sequence and confident delivery. Source: CAT405 Rubric 1.2 System Requirements and Design Presentation.

title.zh: 进度演示强调核心模块与后续计划
title.en: Progress demonstration emphasises core modules and the next plan

explanation.zh: Progress Demonstration 总体占 20%；内部 Progress 30%、Prioritization 10%、Future Plan 10%、Implementation 30%、Module Functionality 20%。优秀进度档提及完成超过 50% 模块，但模块数量之外仍要说明核心模块优先级、算法/代码如何构成、当前功能是否运行及接下来怎么完成。来源：CAT405 Rubric 2.0。
explanation.en: Progress Demonstration contributes 20% overall; internally, Progress is 30%, Prioritization 10%, Future Plan 10%, Implementation 30%, and Module Functionality 20%. The excellent progress band mentions more than 50% of modules completed, but module counts alone do not replace core-module prioritisation, explanation of algorithms/code, working functionality and a plan to finish. Source: CAT405 Rubric 2.0.

title.zh: 最终报告重视实现、组织与 SDG 证据
title.en: Final report emphasises implementation, organisation and SDG evidence

explanation.zh: Final Report 总体占 10%；内部 Contents 40%、Implementation 20%、Organization 20%、SDG 20%。与 SRD 阶段相比，最终版本需要用实际实现和结果支持论证，并把前期目标、方法、测试和社会价值连接起来。来源：CAT405 Rubric 3.1 Final Report。
explanation.en: The Final Report contributes 10% overall; internally, Contents is 40%, Implementation 20%, Organization 20%, and SDG 20%. Compared with the SRD stage, the final version must support its argument with actual implementation and results, linking earlier objectives, methods, testing and societal value. Source: CAT405 Rubric 3.1 Final Report.

title.zh: 最终展示：口头表达与系统证明分别准备
title.en: Final presentation and system demonstration need distinct evidence

explanation.zh: Final Presentation 总体 10%，内部 Clarity 40%、Confidence 30%、Q&A 30%；System Demonstration 总体 20%，内部 Originality 20%、Functionality 30%、Subject Knowledge 40%、Usability 10%。前者关注清楚准确地讲解，后者需要实际系统、智能方法输出、模块运行及可解释性，不能用流畅幻灯片替代系统运行。来源：CAT405 Rubric 3.2、3.3a。
explanation.en: Final Presentation contributes 10% overall, with Clarity 40%, Confidence 30% and Q&A 30% internally. System Demonstration contributes 20%, with Originality 20%, Functionality 30%, Subject Knowledge 40% and Usability 10% internally. The former assesses clear, accurate communication; the latter needs a running system, intelligent-method outputs, functioning modules and explainability. Polished slides cannot substitute for system operation. Source: CAT405 Rubrics 3.2 and 3.3a.

title.zh: 创业潜力需要说明落地机会
title.en: Entrepreneurial potential needs a route to practical opportunity

explanation.zh: Entrepreneurship 总体占 10%，表内以 Entrepreneurial Opportunities 评价能否进一步扩展到预商业化。可以围绕生产/交付、分发、营销、销售与支持等实际环节说明机会和后续条件。它评价潜力与准备，不等于项目已经产生营业收入。来源：CAT405 Rubric 3.3b Entrepreneurship。
explanation.en: Entrepreneurship contributes 10% overall, with Entrepreneurial Opportunities assessing readiness for extension toward pre-commercialisation. Explain opportunities and remaining conditions around production/delivery, distribution, marketing, sales and support. This assesses potential and preparation, not proof that revenue already exists. Source: CAT405 Rubric 3.3b Entrepreneurship.

title.zh: 责任、职业行为与诚信

explanation.zh: Ethics 总体占 10%；内部 Responsibility 30%、涵盖工作文化、及时性、生产力与伦理行为的维度 40%、Integrity 30%。落实为可靠完成承诺、及时沟通进度、尊重他人和诚实透明地说明成果、来源与限制。来源：CAT405 Rubric 3.3c Ethics。
explanation.en: Ethics contributes 10% overall; internally, Responsibility is 30%, a dimension covering working culture, timeliness, productivity and ethical conduct is 40%, and Integrity is 30%. Apply this through reliable commitments, timely progress communication, respect for others, and honest, transparent accounts of results, sources and limitations. Source: CAT405 Rubric 3.3c Ethics.

title.zh: 五、展示模板与反馈闭环
title.en: 5. Presentation templates and the feedback loop

title.zh: 按阶段选择展示重点

explanation.zh: SRD 展示模板侧重背景、相关工作、问题、目标、SDG、方案与设计；Progress 模板突出项目描述、目标、模块、当前系统进度和后续计划；Final 模板增加智能计算亮点、实现讨论和最终系统演示。模板标题是准备线索，应按自己的项目填入证据。来源：CAT405.pdf、CAT405 Project Progress Demo (Template).pdf、CAT405 Final Presentation (Template).pdf。
explanation.en: The SRD presentation template emphasises background, related work, problem, objectives, SDG, solution and design. Progress emphasises project description, objectives, modules, current system progress and the next plan. Final adds intelligent-computing highlights, implementation discussion and the final system demonstration. Template headings guide preparation and need project-specific evidence. Source: CAT405.pdf, CAT405 Project Progress Demo (Template).pdf and CAT405 Final Presentation (Template).pdf.

title.zh: 把评审反馈变成可追踪修改
title.en: Turn review feedback into traceable revisions

explanation.zh: 空白 Feedback Form 区分 SRD、Progress、Final 阶段，并留有项目资料、纠正/意见和 supervisor/examiner 签署栏。它是记录反馈的工具，不代表已有评价。使用时可将意见对应到报告章节、系统修改与验证结果，形成反馈—修改—复查的闭环。来源：CAT403_404_405 (Feedback Form).pdf；最终报告提纲要求修订前期章节。
explanation.en: The blank Feedback Form distinguishes SRD, Progress and Final stages and provides project details, correction/comment fields and supervisor/examiner signatures. It is a feedback-recording tool, not evidence of an existing evaluation. Map comments to report sections, system changes and verification results to create a feedback–revision–review loop. Source: CAT403_404_405 (Feedback Form).pdf; the final-report outline's requirement to revise earlier chapters.

relation.zh: 问题和目标决定方案要解决什么
relation.en: The problem and objectives define what the solution must address

relation.zh: 已有方法的局限为选择方案提供依据
relation.en: Limitations of existing work justify the solution choice

relation.zh: 把方法定位成清楚的贡献和成果
relation.en: Position the method as a clear contribution and deliverable

relation.zh: 将目标转成有边界的需求
relation.en: Translate objectives into bounded requirements

relation.zh: 需求由相应的设计视角表达
relation.en: Express requirements through relevant design views

relation.zh: 开发方法与风险落实到计划
relation.en: Turn development-method and risk decisions into a plan

relation.zh: 数据和运行条件支持实现
relation.en: Data and runtime conditions support implementation

relation.zh: 设计说明应与实际构建一致
relation.en: Design explanations should match the actual build

relation.zh: 实现需要用测试证明行为
relation.en: Testing supplies evidence for implemented behaviour

relation.zh: 需求为测试和验收提供基准
relation.en: Requirements provide the basis for testing and acceptance

relation.zh: 测试结果支撑评价与结论
relation.en: Test results support evaluation and conclusions

relation.zh: SDG 论证要贯穿到最终报告
relation.en: Carry the SDG argument into the final report

relation.zh: 先分清权重层级再安排准备重点
relation.en: Distinguish weight levels before prioritising preparation

relation.zh: 阶段评分要求决定展示证据
relation.en: Stage criteria guide the evidence to present

relation.zh: 最终展示需要实际运行与解释
relation.en: The final presentation needs operation and explanation

relation.zh: 系统价值进一步连接实际采用机会
relation.en: Connect system value to opportunities for adoption

relation.zh: 诚实透明落实在报告和引用
relation.en: Apply honesty and transparency to reporting and citation

relation.zh: 评审意见推动可验证的实现修订
relation.en: Review comments drive verifiable implementation revisions

prompt.zh: 一个提案写着“使用神经网络开发应用”，哪项修改最能使目标与问题对齐？
prompt.en: A proposal says 'develop an application using a neural network'. Which revision best aligns the objective with the problem?

options.zh: 把神经网络改成更新的模型名称，保留原目标
options.en: Replace the neural network with a newer model name while keeping the objective

options.zh: 先描述现有分类错误及影响，再提出可测量的分类改进目标
options.en: Describe current classification errors and their impact, then set a measurable classification-improvement objective

options.zh: 把所有开发工具加入目标列表以体现工作量
options.en: Add every development tool to the objective list to demonstrate workload

options.zh: 把目标改写成完成五个界面，不说明与问题的关系
options.en: Rewrite the objective as completing five screens without connecting them to the problem

explanation.zh: 技术名称说明可能采用什么，问题和可检验目标说明为什么做、成功意味着什么。它们应形成连贯的论证。
explanation.en: A technology name says what might be used; the problem and verifiable objective explain why the work matters and what success means. They should form a coherent argument.

prompt.zh: 哪个描述最符合提案对 Proposed Solution 的要求？
prompt.en: Which description best meets the proposal's requirement for a Proposed Solution?

options.zh: 主要罗列页面数量，把智能方法留到最终答辩再说明
options.en: Mainly list screen counts and defer the intelligent method until the final defence

options.zh: 说明数据如何输入分类方法、如何得到预测，以及预测如何支持目标
options.en: Explain how data enters a classification method, how predictions are produced and how they support the objective

options.zh: 只写所用框架和云服务名称，让读者自行推断算法
options.en: Only name frameworks and cloud services, leaving the algorithm implicit

options.zh: 详细写预期商业收益，用收益代替方法步骤
options.en: Detail expected commercial benefits instead of the method's steps

explanation.zh: 方案必须把所选智能方法与解决问题的过程联系起来；工具清单或收益描述不能代替方法。
explanation.en: The solution must connect the chosen intelligent method to the process of solving the problem; a tool list or benefits statement cannot substitute for the method.

prompt.zh: 已有完整系统，本项目改进它的算法以减少错误，按提案指南最合适的状态是什么？
prompt.en: A completed system already exists, and this project improves its algorithm to reduce errors. Which status best fits the proposal guidelines?

options.zh: Enhancement：改进既有完整系统
options.en: Enhancement: improve an existing completed system

options.zh: New project：只要更换算法就自动算全新项目
options.en: New project: any algorithm replacement automatically makes it new

options.zh: Continuation：任何与旧系统有关的工作都只能归为续作
options.en: Continuation: all work related to an existing system must be a continuation

options.zh: Expected Outcome：项目状态就是成果清单
options.en: Expected Outcome: the project status is the deliverables list

explanation.zh: 指南把已有完整系统的性能、功能或算法改进归为 enhancement；continuation 侧重继续扩展已有工作的范围。
explanation.en: The guidelines classify performance, functionality or algorithm improvement to a completed system as enhancement; continuation focuses on extending the scope of existing work.

prompt.zh: 哪种摘要与 SDG 写法最符合模板？
prompt.en: Which abstract and SDG approach best follows the templates?

options.zh: 摘要复制所有技术细节，SDG 部分只放标志
options.en: Copy all technical details into the abstract and show only an SDG logo

options.zh: 一页内概括项目逻辑，并说明项目成果如何支持所选 SDG
options.en: Summarise the project's logic within one page and explain how its outcomes support the selected SDG

options.zh: 摘要只写背景，等实现后再补目标与方法
options.en: Include only background in the abstract and defer objectives and methods until implementation

options.zh: 列出尽可能多的 SDG，不解释与项目的具体关系
options.en: List as many SDGs as possible without explaining their relationship to the project

explanation.zh: 摘要用于独立概括整个方案；SDG 需要有项目与目标之间的理由。两部分都应表达完整逻辑。
explanation.en: The abstract independently summarises the proposal, while SDG alignment needs a reasoned project-to-goal connection. Both should communicate a complete rationale.

prompt.zh: 哪项改动最能让项目计划可检查？
prompt.en: Which change most improves the checkability of a project plan?

options.zh: 只把每个月涂成不同颜色，避免细化任务
options.en: Give each month a different colour without specifying tasks

options.zh: 只标最终截止日，其他任务统一写进行中
options.en: Mark only the final deadline and label all other tasks as ongoing

options.zh: 用参考文献数量代替项目里程碑
options.en: Replace project milestones with the number of references

options.zh: 给任务配置时间、可验收的里程碑和对应交付物
options.en: Assign timing, verifiable milestones and corresponding deliverables to tasks

explanation.zh: 里程碑和交付物把时间计划转成可观察的完成证据；只有时间区间不能说明要完成什么。
explanation.en: Milestones and deliverables turn a timeline into observable completion evidence; time blocks alone do not specify what must be achieved.

prompt.zh: 怎样的相关工作最能支持方法选择？
prompt.en: Which form of related work best supports the method choice?

options.zh: 比较已有方法在同一问题上的优缺点，并说明所选方法回应哪项不足
options.en: Compare existing methods' strengths and weaknesses on the problem and explain which limitation the chosen method addresses

options.zh: 按年份罗列论文标题，不讨论与项目的关系
options.en: List paper titles by year without discussing their relationship to the project

options.zh: 只选择支持自己方案的结果，省略适用限制
options.en: Include only results favouring the proposal and omit applicability limits

options.zh: 把所有文献引用集中放在附录，正文只写方案名称
options.en: Put all citations in an appendix and name only the solution in the main text

explanation.zh: 比较需要为自己的设计选择提供理由，而不是只显示阅读数量；限制也是方案定位的重要依据。
explanation.en: The comparison should justify design decisions rather than merely demonstrate reading volume; limitations are also important to positioning.

prompt.zh: 访谈中用户提出十项功能，但本阶段只做六项，应怎样写需求？
prompt.en: Users suggest ten features in interviews, but only six are planned for this stage. How should the requirements be documented?

options.zh: 把十项都写成已承诺功能，演示时再解释未完成项
options.en: List all ten as committed features and explain omissions during the demonstration

options.zh: 只写实现的六项，不记录需求获取过程或排除理由
options.en: Write only the six implemented features without elicitation evidence or exclusion reasons

options.zh: 先画界面，直到最终测试时才确定需求范围
options.en: Draw interfaces first and decide the requirements scope during final testing

options.zh: 记录需求依据，明确本阶段六项范围和其余项目的边界或后续安排
options.en: Record the evidence, define the six in-scope features and identify boundaries or future treatment of the others

explanation.zh: 清晰范围将需求证据和当前承诺连接起来，并为设计与验收提供一致标准。
explanation.en: A clear scope connects elicitation evidence with current commitments and provides a consistent basis for design and acceptance.

prompt.zh: 项目界面需求尚不明确，需要多轮用户反馈，哪种论证最合理？
prompt.en: Interface requirements remain uncertain and repeated user feedback is needed. Which justification is strongest?

options.zh: 仅因为模板列出 waterfall 就认定所有项目必须采用它
options.en: Assume waterfall is mandatory for all projects because the outline lists it

options.zh: 先选流行方法名称，项目计划无需随方法改变
options.en: Choose a popular method name without adapting the project plan

options.zh: 只用最终演示作为第一次需求确认机会
options.en: Use the final demonstration as the first opportunity to confirm requirements

options.zh: 选择适合反复验证的原型或迭代方法，并在计划中安排反馈和修改
options.en: Choose a prototyping or iterative approach and schedule feedback and revision

explanation.zh: 提纲列出可选方法，不规定所有项目使用同一种。方法选择需要回应项目的反馈需求并体现在计划中。
explanation.en: The outline lists alternatives rather than mandating one method. The selection should respond to feedback needs and be reflected in the plan.

prompt.zh: 评审想了解两个模块之间调用的先后顺序，哪种补充最直接？
prompt.en: A reviewer wants to understand the order of calls between two modules. Which addition is most direct?

options.zh: 增加适用的序列图，并与模块职责和实现说明对应
options.en: Add an appropriate sequence diagram aligned with module responsibilities and implementation

options.zh: 只增加数据库字段清单，不说明调用顺序
options.en: Add only a database-field list without showing the call sequence

options.zh: 重复绘制项目 Gantt 图作为运行过程说明
options.en: Repeat the project Gantt chart as an explanation of runtime behaviour

options.zh: 把所有 UML 图放入报告，无需解释与问题的联系
options.en: Include every UML diagram without explaining its relationship to the question

explanation.zh: 不同图回答不同问题；序列图能表达交互的先后，而时间计划图描述开发安排。
explanation.en: Different diagrams answer different questions: a sequence diagram expresses interaction order, whereas a project timeline describes development scheduling.

prompt.zh: 一个机器学习项目只列出 Python 和编辑器，SRD 最需要补充什么？
prompt.en: A machine-learning project lists only Python and its editor. What most needs to be added to the SRD?

options.zh: 更多编辑器插件名称，以增加工具清单长度
options.en: More editor-plugin names to lengthen the tool list

options.zh: 数据来源、训练与测试安排，以及支撑方法的运行条件
options.en: Data sources, training/testing arrangements and the runtime conditions supporting the method

options.zh: 最终展示的背景音乐和幻灯片配色
options.en: Background music and presentation colour choices

options.zh: 用模型名称代替数据和评估安排
options.en: A model name instead of data and evaluation arrangements

explanation.zh: 语言和编辑器不能说明数据方法是否可执行或可评估；数据与实施条件是设计依据。
explanation.en: A language and editor do not establish whether a data method can be executed or evaluated; data and implementation conditions are part of the design basis.

prompt.zh: 实现过程中更换了智能算法，最终报告最合理的处理是什么？
prompt.en: The intelligent algorithm changes during implementation. What is the best treatment in the final report?

options.zh: 保留旧设计不动，只在演示中展示新结果
options.en: Leave the old design unchanged and show only the new results in the demonstration

options.zh: 删除原需求，让任何实现都显得满足目标
options.en: Delete the original requirements so any implementation appears satisfactory

options.zh: 只换算法名称，流程、数据和结果保持旧描述
options.en: Change only the algorithm name while retaining old process, data and result descriptions

options.zh: 更新相关设计和实现说明，解释更换理由，并提供对应测试结果
options.en: Update the design and implementation explanation, justify the change and provide corresponding test results

explanation.zh: 最终报告应解释实际系统，并让设计变化、实现证据与结果一致；旧文档不能替代当前事实。
explanation.en: The final report should explain the actual system and align design changes, implementation evidence and results; outdated documentation cannot substitute for current facts.

prompt.zh: 两个模块单独通过测试，连接后数据格式不兼容，最直接暴露问题的是哪一层测试？
prompt.en: Two modules pass their individual tests, but their data formats are incompatible when connected. Which testing level most directly exposes this?

options.zh: 只重复单元测试即可证明模块交互正确
options.en: Repeating only unit tests proves inter-module interaction is correct

options.zh: 只检查报告排版即可替代运行测试
options.en: Checking report formatting substitutes for runtime testing

options.zh: 只做演示彩排即可覆盖所有接口情况
options.en: A demonstration rehearsal alone covers all interface cases

options.zh: Integration testing：检验模块协作
options.en: Integration testing: examine cooperation between modules

explanation.zh: 单元测试关注独立单元，集成测试关注组合后的接口和交互；测试证据应与风险和需求对应。
explanation.en: Unit testing focuses on individual units; integration testing examines interfaces and interactions after combination. Evidence should correspond to risks and requirements.

prompt.zh: 当前系统在低光照数据上表现较差，哪项未来工作最有依据？
prompt.en: The current system performs poorly on low-light data. Which future-work statement is best justified?

options.zh: 承诺换一个模型后必定达到百分之百准确率
options.en: Promise that changing the model will guarantee perfect accuracy

options.zh: 把低光照结果从评价中删除，以避免局限
options.en: Delete low-light results from evaluation to avoid a limitation

options.zh: 补充代表性的低光照数据，并按相同指标验证改进
options.en: Add representative low-light data and evaluate improvement using the same metrics

options.zh: 把未来工作写成扩大用户规模，不说明当前问题
options.en: State only that user numbers will grow without addressing the current issue

explanation.zh: 可检验的改进方案应来自已经观察到的限制，并明确如何评价效果。
explanation.en: A testable improvement should follow an observed limitation and explain how its effect will be evaluated.

prompt.zh: 哪种报告组织最符合模板中正文与附录的分工？
prompt.en: Which organisation best matches the template's division between main text and appendices?

options.zh: 正文只写“见附录”，把所有解释都移出正文
options.en: Write only 'see appendix' in the main text and move every explanation out

options.zh: 正文说明测试策略和关键结果，附录提供编号的完整测试记录
options.en: Explain the test strategy and key results in the main text and provide numbered full records in an appendix

options.zh: 参考文献列出未在正文使用的所有搜索结果
options.en: List every search result as a reference regardless of its use in the text

options.zh: 马来文与英文摘要分别描述不同目标，以展示更广泛的范围
options.en: Describe different objectives in the two abstracts to display a broader scope

explanation.zh: 附录承载细节，正文保留读者理解和评价项目所需的论证；摘要和引用也必须保持一致。
explanation.en: Appendices hold detail, while the main text retains the argument needed to understand and assess the project. Abstracts and citations also need consistency.

prompt.zh: Progress 占总成绩 20%，其中 Implementation 占 Progress 的 30%。Implementation 满分对应总成绩多少个百分点？
prompt.en: Progress contributes 20% overall, with Implementation worth 30% of Progress. How many overall percentage points does full Implementation credit contribute?

options.en: 50 percentage points: 20% + 30%

options.zh: 30 个百分点：直接使用表内维度权重
options.en: 30 percentage points: use the internal criterion weight directly

options.zh: 20 个百分点：整个环节全由该维度构成
options.en: 20 percentage points: treat the criterion as the whole component
6 percentage points: 20% × 30%

explanation.zh: 这两个百分比属于嵌套层级，应相乘而不是相加；该维度并不等于整个 Progress。
explanation.en: The percentages are nested and should be multiplied rather than added; the criterion is not the entire Progress component.

prompt.zh: 报告排版很好但智能方法选择没有理由，最直接缺少哪类 SRD 报告证据？
prompt.en: An SRD report is well formatted but does not justify its intelligent-method choice. Which evidence category is most directly deficient?

options.zh: Organization：只要目录更长就能解决方法理由缺失
options.en: Organization: a longer contents list alone fixes the missing rationale

options.zh: Proposed Solution：方法与设计选择的理由
options.en: Proposed Solution: rationale for method and design choices

options.zh: SDG：只要更换目标编号就能代替方法解释
options.en: SDG: changing the goal number substitutes for a method explanation

options.zh: Contents 中的格式：调整字体即可补全设计依据
options.en: Formatting within Contents: changing the font supplies design justification

explanation.zh: 表内明确要求方案说明所选智能方法、设计和理由；写作规范有价值，但不能替代方法依据。
explanation.en: The rubric asks for the chosen intelligent method, design and rationale. Writing quality matters but cannot substitute for method justification.

prompt.zh: 学生表达自信，但无法解释为何选择该智能方法。最主要的评分缺口是什么？
prompt.en: A student speaks confidently but cannot explain why the intelligent method was selected. What is the main rubric gap?

options.zh: Confidence：只需进一步提高说话音量
options.en: Confidence: only greater speaking volume is needed

options.zh: Logical Organization：只需调换结束页位置
options.en: Logical Organization: only the ending slide needs moving

options.zh: Subject Knowledge：方法理解与理由不足
options.en: Subject Knowledge: insufficient understanding and rationale

options.zh: Completeness：只需加入更多截图而不解释方法
options.en: Completeness: only more screenshots are needed without explaining the method

explanation.zh: 自信和专业理解是不同维度。解释与回答问题的能力直接体现 subject knowledge。
explanation.en: Confidence and subject understanding are distinct dimensions. Explanation and reasoned answers directly demonstrate subject knowledge.

prompt.zh: 完成很多非核心页面但核心算法未实现，下一步准备进度演示时最应改进什么？
prompt.en: Many peripheral screens are complete, but the core algorithm is not implemented. What should be improved most when preparing the progress demonstration?

options.zh: 继续增加容易完成的页面，只追求模块数量
options.en: Add more easy screens and focus solely on module counts

options.zh: 优先完成关键模块，解释实现，并提出余下工作计划
options.en: Prioritise core modules, explain their implementation and plan the remaining work

options.zh: 把未来计划移除，以免暴露尚未完成的工作
options.en: Remove the future plan to avoid showing unfinished work

options.zh: 只展示最终界面草图，把运行功能留到最后一次检查
options.en: Show only final interface mockups and postpone functional checks until the last review

explanation.zh: 评分同时看优先级、实现、功能和计划；大量外围页面不能自动证明核心技术进展。
explanation.en: The rubric assesses prioritisation, implementation, functionality and planning together; numerous peripheral screens do not establish progress on the core technology.

prompt.zh: 提交最终报告时仍只有“预计实现”和“预计效果”，最直接的改进是什么？
prompt.en: A final report still contains only 'planned implementation' and 'expected outcomes'. What is the most direct improvement?

options.zh: 补入实际实现、测试结果和目标达成情况，并同步修订论证
options.en: Add actual implementation, test results and objective attainment, and revise the argument accordingly

options.zh: 保留全部未来时态，只增加更多背景文献
options.en: Retain future tense throughout and add only background references

options.zh: 把预计效果改为确定语气，不增加证据
options.en: Change expected effects to confident assertions without adding evidence

options.zh: 只改封面日期，证明报告已进入最终阶段
options.en: Change only the cover date to indicate the final stage

explanation.zh: 最终报告评价已经完成的工作，必须让实现和结果证据支撑结论；语气或封面不能代替证据。
explanation.en: The final report evaluates completed work and requires implementation and results to support conclusions; wording or a cover date cannot replace evidence.

prompt.zh: 演示界面漂亮，系统能运行，但学生无法解释智能方法如何得到输出，最直接影响哪个系统演示维度？
prompt.en: The interface looks polished and the system runs, but the student cannot explain how the intelligent method produces its outputs. Which system-demonstration dimension is most directly affected?

options.zh: Usability：只与按钮颜色有关，所以改配色即可
options.en: Usability: only button colours matter, so recolouring is sufficient

options.zh: Functionality：只要程序运行就自动证明理解方法
options.en: Functionality: a running program automatically proves method understanding

options.zh: Subject Knowledge：缺少对系统和方法的理解解释
options.en: Subject Knowledge: inability to explain the system and method

options.zh: Confidence：提高演讲速度就能替代技术解释
options.en: Confidence: faster delivery substitutes for technical explanation

explanation.zh: 运行成功、易用性和方法理解是不同证据。评审需要学生能说明问题、方法与输出之间的关系。
explanation.en: Successful execution, usability and method understanding are different forms of evidence. The student must explain the relationship between the problem, method and output.

prompt.zh: 哪种论证最能支持项目的创业潜力？
prompt.en: Which argument best supports the project's entrepreneurial potential?

options.zh: 把技术准确率直接当作收入预测，不说明用户或交付
options.en: Treat technical accuracy as a revenue forecast without explaining users or delivery

options.zh: 只展示一个价格数字，省略产品与客户关系
options.en: Show only a price while omitting the product-customer relationship

options.zh: 明确目标使用者、价值、交付与支持方式，以及进一步落地所需工作
options.en: Identify target users, value, delivery/support arrangements and work needed for practical adoption

options.zh: 宣称所有用户都会购买，因为系统包含 AI
options.en: Claim all users will buy because the system contains AI

explanation.zh: 创业机会的论证需要把项目价值与采用、交付和支持条件联系起来；技术表现本身不等于市场结果。
explanation.en: An opportunity argument links project value to adoption, delivery and support conditions; technical performance alone is not a market outcome.

prompt.zh: 实验结果不如预期，哪种处理最符合诚信与责任要求？
prompt.en: Experimental results are below expectations. Which response best meets integrity and responsibility requirements?

options.zh: 只保留最好的结果并将其描述为所有情况的表现
options.en: Keep only the best result and describe it as performance in all cases

options.zh: 修改图表标签让结果看起来满足目标
options.en: Change chart labels to make results appear to meet the objective

options.zh: 等到最终提交才提及问题，避免中期沟通
options.en: Wait until final submission to mention the problem and avoid interim communication

options.zh: 如实报告结果与限制，及时沟通并提出改进计划
options.en: Report the results and limitations honestly, communicate promptly and propose an improvement plan

explanation.zh: 诚信要求真实透明，责任要求及时沟通和可靠行动；诚实呈现局限也能支持后续改进。
explanation.en: Integrity requires honesty and transparency; responsibility requires timely communication and reliable action. Honest limitations also support improvement.

prompt.zh: 从 SRD 展示转到进度演示，哪项变化最符合阶段要求？
prompt.en: When moving from the SRD presentation to the progress demonstration, which change best fits the stage?

options.zh: 完全重复问题背景，避免展示未完成的系统
options.en: Repeat only the problem background and avoid showing the unfinished system

options.zh: 在设计基础上展示已完成模块的运行与实现，并说明余下计划
options.en: Build on the design by demonstrating completed modules and their implementation, then explain the remaining plan

options.zh: 只补充更多相关工作，不介绍模块运行
options.en: Add more related work without showing module operation

options.zh: 删除目标和模块关系，只保留最终界面截图
options.en: Remove objectives and module relationships and retain only final interface screenshots

explanation.zh: 进度演示需要把设计转化为当前实现证据，同时说明到最终交付之间的剩余工作。
explanation.en: The progress demonstration turns design into evidence of current implementation and explains the work remaining before final delivery.

prompt.zh: 评审要求说明数据选择依据，哪种处理最利于后续复查？
prompt.en: A reviewer asks for justification of the data selection. Which response best supports later review?

options.zh: 只回复“已处理”，不说明改了哪里
options.en: Reply only 'resolved' without identifying the change

options.zh: 删除原反馈，避免最终版本出现待改问题
options.en: Delete the original feedback so no revision issue remains visible

options.zh: 更换模板样式，但不补充数据选择理由
options.en: Change the template styling without explaining data selection

options.zh: 记录该意见，补充对应章节及证据，并注明修改位置和验证情况
options.en: Record the comment, add the relevant explanation and evidence, and identify the revision location and verification

explanation.zh: 可追踪修改把评审意见与具体行动及结果连接起来，方便监督者和学生确认问题是否解决。
explanation.en: Traceable revision connects a review comment to concrete action and results, helping both supervisor and student confirm whether the issue is resolved.
